input: Find a local pottery class to join

gold.taskTitle: Find and Join a Local Pottery Class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and sign up for a pottery class available in their local area.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identifies the geographic area to target when searching for pottery classes.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or have prior pottery experience?
questions.description: Determines the skill level so classes can be filtered by beginner, intermediate, or advanced level.

questions.title: Which days of the week are you available to attend?
questions.description: Narrows down classes that fit the user's weekly schedule.

questions.title: Do you prefer wheel throwing, hand-building, or either?
questions.description: Identifies the pottery discipline or style the user is interested in learning.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per month?
questions.description: Sets a price range to filter out classes that are not financially suitable.

questions.title: Are you looking for a one-time workshop or ongoing weekly classes?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user wants a short commitment or a recurring course.

questions.title: Is there a specific date you want to start by?
questions.description: Establishes a deadline or target start date to prioritize classes with upcoming availability.
